one_line: The paper develops energy performance indicators for manufacturing companies at machine/production-line/factory levels and demonstrates them on a stainless steel manufacturer whose described operations (ovens, pressers, drop hammers, turning, boring, CNC, ring rollers) are discrete forging/machining rather than continuous primary-metal production.
